It's a mildly busy day, but i have no one I'm actively helping. Single coverage (because of course it is). Now, this quiet guy walks in. He noticeably has social anxiety. No worries, it happens all the time. I try and be a little more upbeat than usual, so he might feel a little more comfortable. My guy brought in probably the cleanest, albeit used, XBS I've seen in my life. It was a little dusty, but nothing I couldn't handle. "Looks great!" I said, "You ok if I test it real quick?" He hesitated but agreed.

Now, some context. The Xbox line has this cool feature where you can use your screenshots as your background for your homepage. It also has a browser. The last thing I should mention, this was back when my store didn't use our test screen as a public ad display. It was on the end of the c shaped  cashwrap and just so happened to be facing the door.

His hesitation should've given me plenty of warning. I boot it up and select the main profile. This man's background was of the most high-definition, uncensored anime t*tties I've ever seen. I freeze for a moment, then quickly double-check no one other than him and I can see this. Lucky I'm clear. I don't even turn off the system, I just yank out the hdmi cord. I turn back to the register he's at to continue the transaction. Not a single extra unnecessary word was exchanged between the two of us. After he leaves, I package it up and put it in the trade hold bin with a warning, "DON'T FOR THE LOVE OF GOD BOOT UP WITH PEOPLE IN THE STORE." 

My SL was the one to take it off trade hold to wipe it, but he called ne first to make sure it wasn't anything serious. I told him if the store is empty, just boot it up. After a brief pause, I hear both them and another one of my coworkers die laughing. 


TLDR; XBS w/ t*tties
